Twemoji colour emoji pages for UP-Term

The files 1F0 ... 1FA, 23 ... 32 in this drawer are 1192 emoji of Twemoji
17.0.3: every one named by a single code point that a terminal draws two
cells wide (U+1F000-U+1FAFF, and the emoji-presentation characters of
U+2300-U+32FF). UP-Term's tools/gen_emoji.py scaled each from its 72 px
picture to 16x16 and 16x8 pixels and stored them, one file per 256 code
points, as a palette and indices (at most 16 colours where that keeps
every pixel within 48 of 255 of the art, else the exact colours). UP-Term
draws them over two cells on an RTG screen of 15 bits or more with
cybergraphics.library (Picasso96 or CyberGraphX); elsewhere it draws the
one-colour Unifont glyph.

  Emoji:      Twemoji 17.0.3, https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji
  Taken from: https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji/archive/refs/tags/v17.0.3.tar.gz
              sha256 a0855654b633045ae2337537e77f1bb4361162f7fcd910e613eaab1d6d9c5fca
              (assets/72x72)

scaled down to 16x16 and 16x8 pixels, reduced to at most 16 colours where
the error stays small, and stored in UP-Term's page format. No endorsement
by the licensors is implied.

Rebuild them from the source: make emoji (in the UP-Term source tree).
